title: Save your money
text: Save your money. After only 8 months of holding a few lightweight scarves, the main rod detached and fell to the bottom of my closet. When I picked it up, one of the arms detached. It's now in the trash. The pivoting rack is a great idea that was embarrassingly poorly executed. I definitely have buyer’s remorse. This is the most unsatisfactory product I’ve bought from Amazon.
